## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The change matches the linked sprint or issue scope.
- [ ] Server-side validation and authorization are enforced where applicable.
- [ ] UI changes include loading, empty, error, and success states.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Formatter, linter, type checker, tests, and production build pass.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] The PR targets `develop` (or a `release/*` branch when promoting to `main`).
- [ ] CI checks pass.
- [ ] The diff has been reviewed for debug statements, unsafe code, and missing tests.
